continuity: The party is approaching Suzhou in Jiangsu Province; Prince Shangshan is expected to meet the Emperor today.
Jiangsu has no Murim sects: the Great Nation’s founding emperor ordered the Maoshan Sect and other holdouts destroyed by the Imperial Guards.
Hong Jin chose Jin Taekyung to protect Prince Shangshan because he needs a trusted martial artist powerful enough to save the prince from any threat.
plot: Hong Jin explains that the imperial court’s long-standing suppression of Murim sects around the imperial capital began when the Great Nation’s founder ordered Jiangsu’s sects to relocate. The Maoshan Sect and a few others refused; the Imperial Guards destroyed them, leaving Jiangsu without Murim sects.

As the party approaches Suzhou, Jin Taekyung realizes they cannot rely on local Murim forces for help and understands why Hong Jin asked him to protect Prince Shangshan. Jeong Hogun announces that the prince is to pay his respects to the Emperor that day.
translation_decisions: Render 茅山派 as “Maoshan Sect,” 太祖 as “Taizu,” 南京 as “Nanjing,” and 蘇州 (소주) as “Suzhou.”

active_continuity: The Divine Physician secured the Blood Soul Gu from the deceased City Lord of Sichuan Province; it weakens hosts, causes madness, and eventually kills them.
Jin suspects Dark Heaven killed the City Lord as part of a scheme against the Great Nation, possibly its imperial family.
Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao is traveling to the imperial capital with Hong Jin, the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and Jin’s party; he is expected to meet the Emperor today.
Hong Jin chose Jin Taekyung to protect Zhu Bao because he trusts him to defend the prince against any threat.
Jeong Hogun commands the Embroidered Uniform Guard escorting Zhu Bao discreetly.
The late Emperor entrusted Hong Jin with Zhu Bao’s care, and Zhu Bao trusts his elder brother.
Zhu Bao gave Hyuk Mujin the joking title “Tenfold Man,” which Mujin inscribed on a bronze token.
Jiangsu has no Murim sects: the founding emperor destroyed the Maoshan Sect and other sects that refused to relocate.
open_questions: Why did Dark Heaven secretly kill the City Lord, and is it targeting the Emperor or imperial family?
What does the Emperor intend for Prince Shangshan, and what prompted the imperial decree against Hong Jin?
What does Zhu Bao’s secret letter to Jin contain?
What do the Commander-in-Chief or Emperor know about the party, and who predicted that uninvited guests would interfere?
Who trained the Embroidered Uniform Guard’s highly skilled martial artists, and for what purpose?
